Since no start date or period length is stated, no exact due date can be computed; practically this should be done promptly and in any case before the 2026-12-02 payment deadline to avoid being treated as non-disputing, but the letter itself sets no binding date for this action.

warnings: This is a debt-collection (Inkasso) demand from a private company acting for Beispielnetz Kabel GmbH, not an authority decision — it carries no legal force of its own and has no Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung; before paying, verify the underlying claim (the August/September 2026 invoices and the 12.10.2026 reminder) directly with Beispielnetz Kabel GmbH if you have any doubt it is genuine or already paid.

The IBAN given (DE20 3705 0198 0005 5664 00) is a validly formatted German IBAN, but a valid IBAN does not prove who owns the account — confirm the payee name shown by your bank's mandatory name-check matches 'Inkassobüro Beispielrecht GmbH' before transferring any money, and do not rely solely on this letter for new payment details.

No specific deadline is given for the alternative action of disputing the claim ('Wenn Sie die Forderung bestreiten...'), so that obligation could not be dated precisely; the only firm date in the letter is the 2026-12-02 payment deadline.
